annotations.annotation_text: Joyce's recurring mystical or structural number (four): encoding cabalistic intervals, Viconian divisions, and historical Dublin dates.
sources: Hart, Clive. Structure and Motif in Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/structuremotifin0000hart
McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/annotationstofin0000mchu_h5g8

annotations.annotation_text: The theme of the cosmic and comic Fall (fall): Tim Finnegan tumbling from his ladder, Humpty Dumpty shattered from the wall, and Adam falling in Eden, awaiting whiskey-fuelled resurrection.
sources: The Ballad of Tim Finnegan's Wake. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnegan%27s_Wake
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe
Opie, Iona and Peter. The Oxford Dictionary of Nursery Rhymes. https://archive.org/details/oxforddictionary0000unse_m4u1

annotations.annotation_text: The nocturnal oneiric dimension (night): Joyce's exploration of the sleeping body, sensory deprivation, auditory distortions, and the somatic language of the collective unconscious.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349

annotations.annotation_text: The Twelve Jurors / Tavern Drinkers (tap): representing the chorus of public opinion, the twelve signs of the Zodiac, the Apostles, and the customers gossiping in HCE's Chapelizod pub.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp

annotations.annotation_text: The primal text / Mama Livia's Letter retrieved from the Boston dump by Biddy Doran the Hen (hen), representing the genesis of writing, literature, and the archaeological decipherment of history.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Deane, Vincent, et al. The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. https://www.brepols.net
